cost: Expected O(1) map lookup/insert, sorted names O(K log K); dims extraction O(arguments + trailing dimensions). Casting and downstream shape multiplication are not overflow certificates.
description: Builtin registry and shared value/shape extraction adapters used by numerical and I/O modules.
forward: register overwrites a name's function; names sorts keys; with_defaults registers eleven modules in fixed order. scalar_arg returns first real element if nonempty. dims_args ignores char values, floors positive sizes, clamps nonpositive to zero and requires trailing dimensions equal one.
inverse: names excludes hash iteration nondeterminism in its returned order. scalar_arg excludes rejecting a nonempty nonscalar solely for its size. NaN dimension excludes a successful dims_args result.

Registry snapshot admits arbitrary overwritten registrations and insertion permutations with same final bindings. Dimensions admit fractional/negative antecedents after floor/clamp and arbitrary skipped char arguments.
limitations: Partial source-bound model, not semantic proof
Finite synthetic fixtures only; frozen suites/external measurement unexecuted
state: A single scalar dimension means square, no numeric arguments means 1x1, empty dimension vector means 0x0. default_dim chooses rows unless rows==1; dim_arg absent/empty/char yields None.
